entities.name: Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis
observations: Acute angioinvasive Mucorales sinus infection favored by poorly controlled diabetes and immunosuppression; black necrotic eschar of the nares or palate is a classic tissue-infarction sign.

entities.name: Orbital apex extension
observations: Impaired extraocular movements indicate involvement of extraocular motor nerves or muscles and strongly suggest orbital-apex or cavernous-sinus extension in rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis.

entities.name: Intracranial spread
observations: Altered mental status is the most concerning listed sign when specifically assessing cerebral or meningeal extension, but it is less targeted than ophthalmoplegia for orbital-apex or cavernous-sinus disease.
